items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: Mr. LaCrosse made me assistant manager of the department.

ctx.x: I mean, the presence of fraternities, carnival clubs, and various other organizations, and it would be quite a big thing. And so they got a lot of this engagement, and they sounded like it. So I played, I actually played with over 200 different New Orleans musicians, and I had the names of practically all of them. I just remembered them through the years, and I wrote them down after I left down there, because I knew I liked them and had so much fun with them. But when my fortunes improved, after a while, one of…
What was the name of the restaurant?
